query: UPDATE twitch_clips_social_analytics SET views = $1, likes = $2, comments = $3, shares = $4, watch_time_seconds = $5, ctr_percent = $6::double precision, engagement_rate = $7::double precision, provider = $8, synced_at = $9::text::timestamptz, next_pull_at = $10::text::timestamptz WHERE clip_id = $11 AND platform = $12 AND bucket = $13
